mastery_task.scenario_en: You register a fictional learner for a community class in a simulated form.
mastery_task.scenario_ar: تسجّل متعلمًا خياليًا في دورة مجتمعية داخل نموذج محاكي.
mastery_task.prompt_en: Enter the required values, choose country and nationality, check, and submit.
mastery_task.support: Field labels and interface instructions only; no prefilled answers.
mastery_task.freshness: The person, layout, field order, month, and selection controls differ from practice.

replacement_mastery_task.scenario_en: You complete a simulated volunteer form for a different fictional person.
replacement_mastery_task.scenario_ar: تكمل نموذج تطوع محاكي لشخص خيالي مختلف.
replacement_mastery_task.prompt_en: Transfer the same detail types, check the new layout, and submit.
replacement_mastery_task.support: Field labels and interface instructions only; no prefilled answers.
replacement_mastery_task.freshness: New values and controls preserve the construct without repeating the first form.

rubric.level_2: Field labels and action prompts are interpreted correctly.
All required values are entered accurately and submitted after review.
A changed layout and month are handled without fixed-position memory.
A missing or swapped field is found and corrected before submit.

decision.demonstrated: Level 2 or above on every required dimension.
decision.needs_review: Any required dimension below level 2; use targeted practice and a new task.
decision.completion_rule: Opening sections or finishing exercises never grants mastery.

teach_back_variant.prompt_ar: اشرح الفرق بين Enter your first name وSelect your nationality، وليه المراجعة قبل Submit مهمة.

omit_variant.content: Proceed directly to the matched close and review card.

delayed_review.task: Complete four fields in a changed layout.
Repair swapped country and nationality values.
Complete and check a fresh simulated form.
